name: Cinnamon
source:
Cinnamon (シナモン) is an inhabitant from the world of love and dreams who travels to Hinamizawa. He appears in Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Mei in a collaboration event with Sanrio.

[From 07th Expansion wikia]
